name: ling-skills
description: Ling's shared skill library. Skills are portable processes: build one, publish it here, let anyone fork it.

plugins.name: getting-started
plugins.description: Turn an empty folder into a working Claude memory: a five-question interview, then a CLAUDE.md and a memory/ folder. No template, no PARA, nothing to maintain.

plugins.name: feedback-tools
plugins.description: Turn a batch of raw user feedback into a frequency-weighted, prioritized list of themes with owners.

plugins.name: brand-design
plugins.description: Apply Ling brand guidelines — colors, Poppins typography, mascot and illustration rules, scene templates — to any visual design or Canva output.

plugins.name: creative
plugins.description: Generate Ling-branded word art sticker PNGs -- a word in the Ling title lettering, optionally with a mascot or Word-Icon graphic, on a transparent background. Needs an OpenAI API key; about $0.01 per image.

plugins.name: meetings
plugins.description: Append decisions and missing action items from Google Meet Gemini notes into the matching ClickUp meeting-notes page, for meetings you organize.

plugins.name: seo-audit
plugins.description: Full SEO audit of any URL: technical, on-page, content quality, schema, and dual AI Readiness + AI Visibility scores, delivered as a print-ready PDF report artifact.
